newsitem.title: GERMANY: WestLB says no decision yet on Inkombank stake.
newsitem.headline: WestLB says no decision yet on Inkombank stake.

text.p: Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale said on Friday it had not yet reached a decision on whether to buy a stake in Russia's third biggest bank, Inkombank.

"We are cooperation partners and have close links but whether the relationship will be underpinned by a capital stake has yet to be decided," a WestLB spokesman said in response to a Reuter enquiry. The spokesman declined to elaborate.
Inkombank said on Friday it was in talks on selling up to 15 percent of its shares to foreign banks and that potential investors were the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and WestLB.
WestLB and Moscow-based Inkombank in May signed an agreement to work together in the areas of corporate finance, foreign trade finance, project finance and currency clearing.
